edges.effect_quant: The strongest quantitative studies point in a harmful direction, but the pooled magnitude varies across populations and methods.
edges.mechanism: Benzene metabolites damage hematopoietic stem cells and bone-marrow DNA repair, which is why leukemia is its signature cancer outcome.
edges.summary: The strongest piece here is the 2022 Zhang meta analysis in J Environ Sci (China), which ties benzene exposure to leukemia in a direction that later studies largely support. That makes this edge more about calibrating magnitude and context than arguing over whether the signal exists at all.
edges.caveats: Residual confounding and reverse causation remain possible in some observational studies, so the main readout is direction and plausibility rather than one exact risk number.
